about: A machine saved by the game as it was before the START plate and the narrower field (main at a902588a, storage version 10, a field a hundred units wide): written by that version’s own serialize, imported from a copy of main and not from this branch. A machine started from seed 20261015 was fed a medal every half second, the rails taking turns either side of the middle; a prize ball was let go every six seconds while fewer than three lay on the field, and forty medals were paid as towers every twenty seconds. It was saved in the step in which a ball that had come over the lip at the catcher a quarter of a second earlier had been there for that long: that version shows such a ball rolling down the catcher’s slide, and has it meanwhile at the foot of the pusher’s face, under the catcher, where no ball can be under today’s START plate.
